label: Uneasy
summary: The Iran war is still the backdrop, and fighting in Yemen is spreading: Gulf states condemned Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia. Ukraine launched more than 1,000 drones at Russia and set oil facilities in St Petersburg on fire. Israel halted commercial shipments into Gaza, and in Congo former president Joseph Kabila joined the rebellion. France counted the cost of its worst unrest in years, and Macron condemned nationwide rioting and looting. Kenya confirmed an eighth Ebola case, and a fire at a Canadian military base killed four soldiers. There was some brighter news. China's economy grew 4.5% on strong exports, and Pope Leo drew large crowds in his first major appearance since surgery. Physicists reported a new quantum state, researchers mapped brain pathways behind lasting depression relief, and scientists proposed ocean sanctuaries for leatherback turtles. The weighted formula gave 41; no editorial adjustment.
